M13 — 2026-10-10
To commit only your hunks of a file a peer's uncommitted work also touches: split `git diff -U0 -- <file>` into hunks, keep yours, `git apply --cached --unidiff-zero <patch>`, check `git diff --cached`, then plain `git commit -F <msg>` with NO pathspec — `git commit -- <path>` is --only mode and commits the worktree copy, peer hunks included. schema-fingerprint.txt is one line per event type, so it splits by hunk the same way. drive-lanes 2.6 did this with node_modules/.cache/stage26.mjs.
